from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowRepaymentItem(BaseModel):
    """A line item from a company's cash flow statement about cash paid for debt repayment."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name this item belongs to")
    item_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label as written in the statement (e.g. 偿还债务支付的现金)")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount value, numeric")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency/unit as written (e.g. 元)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this item (e.g. 2024年第一季度)")
    statement_section: str | None = Field(description="Which section of the cash flow statement this appears in (e.g. 筹资活动)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text from the document containing this item")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_repayment_items: list[CashFlowRepaymentItem]
